Transcription profiling by array.readouts: gene expression signatures, age-related transcripts/modules, BioAge score, 15-gene predictor, differentially expressed genes and pathway enrichment

Flow Cytometry.readouts: frequencies of B-cell, T-cell and innate immune cell subsets; marker intensity including CD40; predictors of HBV vaccine response

Luminex xMAP.readouts: cytokine and chemokine concentrations associated with HBV vaccine response

ELISA.readouts: anti-HBsAg, anti-diphtheria, anti-tetanus and anti-cholera antibody titers

haematologic measurements.readouts: red blood cell count and other complete blood count markers associated with HBV vaccine response
